results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with a neutral grip.
Place your right forearm on your right thigh, allowing your wrist to extend beyond your knee. Keep your left hand resting on your left thigh for support.
Curl the dumbbell upward by flexing your wrist, squeezing your forearm muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, extending your wrist. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your forearm stable and only move your wrist to isolate the forearm muscles.
Use a controlled motion to avoid using momentum.
Maintain a neutral grip throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with your palm facing up, and rest your right forearm on your thigh, allowing your wrist to hang slightly off your knee.
Curl the dumbbell upward by curling your wrist, bringing the weight as high as possible.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, extending your wrist downward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left hand and perform the same steps.
tips: Keep your forearm stationary on your thigh throughout the movement.
Use a controlled motion to prevent momentum from aiding the lift.
Focus on using only your wrist to lift the dumbbell, minimizing elbow movement.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel on the floor in front of a bench, placing both forearms over the bench while holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip (palm facing down).
Rest your wrists just off the edge of the bench, allowing the dumbbells to hang downward.
Curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists, lifting the weight as high as possible while keeping your forearms flat on the bench.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, fully extending your wrists. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your forearms pressed firmly against the bench to isolate the wrist movement.
Use a controlled motion to lift and lower the dumbbells, avoiding any jerking movements.
Avoid using your shoulder or upper arm to lift the weight.
results.description: Dumbbell Over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel on the floor in front of a bench, placing both forearms over the bench while holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip (palms facing up).
Rest your wrists just off the edge of the bench, allowing the dumbbells to hang downward.
Curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists, lifting the weights as high as possible while keeping your forearms flat on the bench.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, fully extending your wrists. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your forearms pressed firmly against the bench to isolate the wrist movement.
Use a controlled motion to lift and lower the dumbbells, avoiding any jerking movements.
Avoid using your shoulder or upper arm to lift the weight.
results.description: Dumbbell Over Bench Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing down). Rest your forearms on your thighs, letting your wrists hang over the edge of your knees.
Start with your wrists in a neutral position, holding the dumbbells so that they point straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up by extending your wrists upwards.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; focus on slow and controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them back down.
Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbells to prevent them from slipping.
results.description: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists hanging over the edge of your knees.
Begin with your wrists in a neutral position, then curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists.
Hold the contraction briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your forearms stationary on your thighs throughout the exercise.
Focus on moving only your wrists; avoid using your arms to lift the weights.
Choose a weight that allows for proper form and control.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands with an underhand grip (palms facing forward). Let your arms hang straight down in front of your hips.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl your wrists upward as far as possible, bringing the dumbbell up towards your forearms.
Squeeze your forearm muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, fully extending your wrists. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms and elbows close to your body; only your wrists should move.
Avoid using momentum; perform the movement in a controlled manner.
Use a weight that allows you to perform the exercise with proper form.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: EZ Bar Seated Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip (palms facing up). Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just beyond the edge, allowing the bar to hang down.
Curl your wrists upward by flexing your forearms, lifting the EZ bar as high as possible while keeping your forearms stationary on your thighs.
Squeeze your forearms at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner, allowing your wrists to fully extend.
tips: Keep your forearms stationary on your thighs throughout the exercise.
Use a controlled motion and avoid using momentum or swinging the bar.
Avoid lifting your forearms off your thighs to ensure proper isolation of the forearm muscles.
results.description: EZ Bar Seated Wrist Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with an ez barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up, holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Let your wrist bend back and lower the bell.
Curl your wrist up as far as possible.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch hands.
tips: Only your wrist moves.
Use a light kettlebell.
results.description: Kettlebell Wrist Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm down, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist lower.
Raise the back of your hand as far as possible.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch hands.
tips: Use a light weight.
Move only at the wrist.
results.description: Kettlebell Wrist Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.
